label: Dress and one-piece
description: Named day dresses, evening dresses, formal gowns, jumpsuits, rompers, catsuits and bodysuits.
notes: Dresses and garments joining the upper and lower body in one piece belong here, from daywear to formal gowns and fitted bodysuits. clothing.top and clothing.bottom own separate garments, with bib overalls in clothing.bottom; clothing.traditional also catalogs culturally specific dress such as the cheongsam and kaftan. Values are single garment names that follow wearing, without a chosen color, accessories or a complete outfit. Dress silhouettes carry feminine presentation tags, work coveralls remain unrestricted, and sheer or fetish one-pieces are adult-only. Revivable silhouettes stay available in contemporary settings without an era restriction.
